params.1273: Complete a lap of the Burthorpe Agility Course.
params.1274: You will find the agility course in Burthorpe. Click on each obstacle in turn, starting with the log.
params.2225:
Completing each agility obstacle gives you Agility XP. Completing the full course in succession gives a lap bonus of XP, so it's always worth finishing the lap.

A higher Agility skill allows you to run further before becoming exhausted.
